parameters.definition_en: Elastic: the material never yields and the strength parameters are only used to compute the strength factor. Plastic: the material yields when the stress reaches the failure criterion and then follows the peak and residual strength and dilation inputs.
parameters.definition_es: Elástico: el material no plastifica nunca y los parámetros resistentes solo sirven para calcular el factor de resistencia. Plástico: el material plastifica al alcanzar el criterio de rotura y sigue la resistencia de pico, la residual y la dilatancia introducidas.
parameters.range_en: Options: Elastic | Plastic
parameters.range_es: Opciones: Elástico | Plástico
parameters.locator: RS2 Help, Strength Properties, 'Material Type' (Elastic or Plastic); RSData MC theory manual p. 2 (elasto-brittle-plastic in general, elasto-perfectly plastic when residual = peak)
parameters.notes: Software concept with no scientific original (kind: manual). RS2 help and the RSData capture (Referencias/Ejemplos/RSData_analisis/05_profundizacion.md: 'Material Type: Elastic | Plastic') list only two options; there is NO 'Brittle' material type. Brittle behaviour is obtained with Plastic and residual strength below peak (see set_residual_to_peak). The OGR registry currently offers only 'Plastic'.

parameters.definition_en: Intercept c of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope on the shear-stress axis: the shear strength at zero normal stress before any loss of strength. In Softening-Hardening it is the cohesion reached at failure by the hardening law.
parameters.definition_es: Ordenada en el origen c de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb: resistencia al corte con tensión normal nula antes de cualquier pérdida de resistencia. En Softening-Hardening es la cohesión que alcanza la ley de endurecimiento en rotura.
parameters.range_en: Granular soils: c' = 0. Compacted soils (USBR data, effective envelope): 0-342 kPa as compacted, 0-22 kPa saturated. Rock masses (RMR classes V to I): < 100 to > 400 kPa.
parameters.range_es: Suelos granulares: c' = 0. Suelos compactados (datos USBR, envolvente efectiva): 0-342 kPa compactado, 0-22 kPa saturado. Macizos rocosos (clases RMR V a I): < 100 a > 400 kPa.
parameters.locator: Definition: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 1 and Fig. 1; Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 1 (PDF p. 79). Ranges: GEC 5 §5.6.2.4 p. 163 (c' = 0 granular); UFC 3-220-01N Table 8-1.4 pp. 8-20 to 8-24 (PDF pp. 48-52), columns 'Cohesion (as compacted)' and 'Cohesion (saturated)', range taken over all USCS groups; Hoek 2023 ch. 12 Table 4 part D, after Bieniawski 1989 (PDF p. 246). SH meaning: RSData SH manual eq. for the cone (ultimate friction/cohesion).
parameters.notes: Coulomb (1776) / Mohr (1900) originals not read; attribution through Drucker & Prager 1952 ('extended Coulomb's rule', 'Mohr-Coulomb hypothesis') and Hoek 2023. GEC 5 Fig. 75 also gives c'/sigma_p' = 0.024-0.10 for overconsolidated clays (Mesri & Abdel-Ghaffar 1993). UFC 3-220-01N is cancelled/superseded but is the version in the library.

parameters.definition_en: Slope angle phi of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope: the rate at which shear strength grows with normal stress before any loss of strength. In Softening-Hardening it is the ultimate (failure) friction angle that the mobilised friction angle hardens towards.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo phi de la pendiente de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb: ritmo al que crece la resistencia al corte con la tensión normal antes de cualquier pérdida de resistencia. En Softening-Hardening es el ángulo de rozamiento último (en rotura) al que tiende el ángulo movilizado.
parameters.range_en: Soils: 15-45 deg (clays up to about 30 deg, sands higher); clean quartz sands 30-50 deg; compacted soils 19 deg (CH) to > 38 deg (GW, SW). Rock masses (RMR classes V to I): < 15 to > 45 deg.
parameters.range_es: Suelos: 15-45° (arcillas hasta unos 30°, arenas más); arenas cuarzosas limpias 30-50°; suelos compactados de 19° (CH) a > 38° (GW, SW). Macizos rocosos (clases RMR V a I): < 15° a > 45°.
parameters.locator: Definition: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 1, Fig. 1; Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 1 (PDF p. 79). Ranges: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.4 p. 15; GEC 5 §5.6.2.4 p. 163; UFC 3-220-01N Table 8-1.4 (PDF pp. 48-52), column 'Effective stress envelope, deg'; Hoek 2023 ch. 12 Table 4 part D after Bieniawski 1989 (PDF p. 246).
parameters.notes: Coulomb (1776) / Mohr (1900) originals not read (see pending). GEC 5 Table 34 (after Meyerhof 1956) relates phi of cohesionless soils to SPT N: < 30 deg very loose to > 45 deg very dense.

parameters.definition_en: Tension cut-off T: the minor principal stress cannot exceed this tensile value (yield surface sigma3 - T = 0, associated flow). It truncates the apex of the shear envelope, which on its own would allow too large tensile stresses in a cohesive material.
parameters.definition_es: Corte a tracción T: la tensión principal menor no puede superar este valor de tracción (superficie sigma3 - T = 0, flujo asociado). Trunca el vértice de la envolvente de corte, que por sí sola admitiría tracciones excesivas en un material con cohesión.
parameters.range_en: 0 for a material without tensile strength (program default). Intact rock (77 Canadian rocks, CANMET Table 1): about 0.4-26 MPa.
parameters.range_es: 0 para un material sin resistencia a tracción (valor por defecto). Roca intacta (77 rocas canadienses, tabla 1 de CANMET): de unos 0,4 a 26 MPa.
parameters.locator: RSData MC manual eq. 0.7 (p. 5); RSData DP manual eq. 0.3 (p. 4); Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §6/7, pp. 43-44 (why the Coulomb apex is cut off); CANMET 1995 Table 1, column sigma_t (PDF pp. 102-109), min 0.43 MPa (coal) to 25.96 MPa (andesite), range computed from the table.
parameters.notes: CANMET prints sigma_t as negative; one value (sulphide iron 27.90 MPa) differs between Tables 1 and 2 of the source and was left out of the range. No source found for soil or rock-mass tensile strength values (see pending).

parameters.definition_en: When checked, the residual strength parameters equal the peak ones, so the material is elastic-perfectly plastic (no strength drop after yield). When unchecked, the residual values apply after yield and the strength drops instantly from peak to residual (elastic-brittle-plastic).
parameters.definition_es: Activado, los parámetros residuales son iguales a los de pico y el material es elastoplástico perfecto (sin caída de resistencia tras la plastificación). Desactivado, tras la plastificación se aplican los valores residuales y la resistencia cae de golpe del pico al residual (elastofrágil-plástico).
parameters.range_en: On | Off
parameters.range_es: Activado | Desactivado
parameters.locator: RSData MC manual p. 2; DP manual p. 1; HB manual p. 2 ('elasto-brittle-plastic in general... residual equal to peak gives elasto-perfect-plastic'); RS2 Help, Strength Properties (residual = peak gives an 'ideally' elastic-plastic material).
parameters.notes: Software option with no scientific original (kind: manual). The underlying peak/residual concept is in Hoek 2023 ch. 4 Fig. 1 and GEC 5 §5.6.2.2.

parameters.definition_en: Tension cut-off T that applies once the material has failed (after the drop from peak to residual).
parameters.definition_es: Corte a tracción T que se aplica una vez el material ha roto (tras la caída de pico a residual).
parameters.range_en: Not greater than the peak tensile strength; 0 is the program default.
parameters.range_es: No mayor que la resistencia a tracción de pico; 0 es el valor por defecto.
parameters.locator: RSData MC manual eq. 0.7 and p. 2 (peak and residual values, instant drop); RSData DP manual eq. 0.3 and p. 1.
parameters.notes: Software concept (kind: manual). The bound 'not greater than peak' follows from the manuals' description of residual as a lower state; no document gives numeric values (see pending).

parameters.definition_en: Cohesion intercept of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope after failure, once the strength has dropped from peak to residual. For discontinuities and clays sheared to large displacement it is usually taken as zero.
parameters.definition_es: Cohesión de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído del pico al residual. En discontinuidades y arcillas cizalladas a grandes desplazamientos suele tomarse nula.
parameters.range_en: 0 at residual for discontinuities and clays; not greater than peak cohesion.
parameters.range_es: 0 en estado residual para discontinuidades y arcillas; no mayor que la cohesión de pico.
parameters.locator: Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 2 and Fig. 1 (PDF p. 79: at residual c has dropped to zero); GEC 5 §5.6.2.2 eq. 59 p. 162 (tau_r = sigma' tan phi_r); RSData MC manual p. 2.
parameters.notes: No source gives a non-zero typical range.

parameters.definition_en: Friction angle of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope after failure, once the strength has dropped to its residual value at large displacement. It is lower than or equal to the peak friction angle.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de rozamiento de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído a su valor residual a grandes desplazamientos. Es menor o igual que el ángulo de pico.
parameters.range_en: Clayey soils: about 5-32 deg, lower for higher clay fraction and liquid limit. Unfilled rock joints with little movement: 20-40 deg depending on rock type.
parameters.range_es: Suelos arcillosos: de unos 5 a 32°, menor cuanto mayores son la fracción arcillosa y el límite líquido. Juntas de roca sin relleno y con poco movimiento: 20-40° según la roca.
parameters.locator: Definition: Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 2 (PDF p. 79); GEC 5 §5.6.2.2 eq. 59 p. 162. Ranges: GEC 5 Fig. 76 p. 166 (after Stark & Eid 1994), read from the curves (about 32 deg at low LL and CF <= 20 %, about 5 deg for CF >= 50 % and high LL); GEC 5 Table 43 p. 214 (after Barton 1973; Jaeger & Cook 1976).
parameters.notes: The clay range is read from a chart, so it is approximate. GEC 5 Table 43 values are friction angles of unfilled planar joints, used here as indicative of residual joint friction.

parameters.definition_en: Dilatancy angle psi: the angle that replaces phi in the plastic potential and sets the ratio of plastic volume increase to plastic shear strain. psi = phi gives associated flow, psi < phi non-associated, and psi = 0 no plastic volume change.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de dilatancia psi: sustituye a phi en el potencial plástico y fija la relación entre el aumento de volumen plástico y la deformación plástica de corte. psi = phi da flujo asociado, psi < phi no asociado y psi = 0 sin cambio de volumen plástico.
parameters.range_en: About 0-20 deg for soils, concrete and rock; about 15 deg for very dense sand, a few degrees for loose sand, 0 for normally consolidated clay. Must not exceed the (residual) friction angle.
parameters.range_es: Entre 0 y 20° aproximadamente para suelos, hormigón y roca; unos 15° en arena muy densa, pocos grados en arena suelta y 0 en arcilla normalmente consolidada. No debe superar el ángulo de rozamiento (residual).
parameters.locator: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 eqs. 3.2-3.3 (p. 12-13), eqs. 4.14-4.16 (pp. 18-19), §3.3 pp. 13-15 (values), §3.4 p. 15 (phi much greater than psi); RSData MC manual eq. 0.6 (p. 2: psi <= residual phi).
parameters.notes: Vermeer & de Borst attribute the plane-strain plastic potential to Radenkovic (1961), not read.

parameters.definition_en: Pressure-sensitivity coefficient of the Drucker-Prager cone sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0 (tension positive): how much the shear strength grows with mean stress. It corresponds to 3*alpha in Drucker & Prager's yield function alpha J1 + sqrt(J2) = k; q = 0 is the von Mises cylinder.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de sensibilidad a la presión del cono de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0 (tracción positiva): cuánto crece la resistencia al corte con la tensión media. Equivale a 3·alfa en la función de fluencia de Drucker y Prager alfa J1 + sqrt(J2) = k; q = 0 es el cilindro de von Mises.
parameters.range_en: 0 (no pressure dependence) up to sqrt(3)/2 = 0.866 when matched to Mohr-Coulomb in plane strain (12 alpha^2 <= 1, i.e. sin phi <= 1).
parameters.range_es: De 0 (sin dependencia de la presión) a sqrt(3)/2 = 0,866 cuando se ajusta a Mohr-Coulomb en deformación plana (12 alfa² <= 1, es decir sen phi <= 1).
parameters.locator: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 2 (p. 158), eq. 10 (p. 159: 3 alpha / (1 - 3 alpha^2)^0.5 = sin phi), p. 160 (12 alpha^2 cannot exceed unity); RSData DP manual eq. 0.1. The upper bound q = 3 alpha <= 3/sqrt(12) is computed from that statement.
parameters.notes: Dimensionless. The identification q = 3 alpha comes from comparing the RSData form (q I1/3) with Drucker & Prager's (alpha J1, J1 = I1). The plane-strain match to c is given under peak_k. Other matchings (e.g. to triaxial compression) give other bounds; none was read.

parameters.definition_en: Cohesion-like constant of the Drucker-Prager cone sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0: the value of sqrt(J2) at failure when the mean stress is zero. It is the constant k of Drucker & Prager's yield function and, in plane strain, is linked to the Mohr-Coulomb c and phi.
parameters.definition_es: Constante de tipo cohesivo del cono de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0: valor de sqrt(J2) en rotura con tensión media nula. Es la constante k de la función de fluencia de Drucker y Prager y, en deformación plana, se relaciona con c y phi de Mohr-Coulomb.
parameters.locator: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 2 (p. 158) and eq. 10 (p. 159: c = k / (1 - 12 alpha^2)^0.5); RSData DP manual eq. 0.1.
parameters.notes: Stress unit (kPa in the program). No source gives typical values; k follows from c and phi via Drucker & Prager eq. 10 (plane strain).

parameters.definition_en: Drucker-Prager pressure coefficient q that applies after failure, once the strength has dropped from peak to residual.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de presión q de Drucker-Prager que se aplica tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído del pico al residual.
parameters.range_en: Same bounds as peak q (0 to 0.866 under the plane-strain Mohr-Coulomb match).
parameters.range_es: Mismos límites que q de pico (0 a 0,866 con el ajuste a Mohr-Coulomb en deformación plana).
parameters.locator: RSData DP manual p. 1 (peak and residual values of q and k, instant drop); Drucker & Prager 1952 p. 160 for the bound.
parameters.notes: The peak/residual split is a software concept (kind: manual).

parameters.definition_en: Drucker-Prager constant k that applies after failure, once the strength has dropped from peak to residual.
parameters.definition_es: Constante k de Drucker-Prager que se aplica tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído del pico al residual.
parameters.locator: RSData DP manual p. 1 and eq. 0.1.
parameters.notes: Software concept (kind: manual); no typical values in any document read.

parameters.definition_en: Coefficient q_psi that replaces q in the Drucker-Prager plastic potential sqrt(J2) + q_psi I1/3 = const and controls plastic volume change. q_psi = q gives the associated flow of Drucker & Prager (dilatancy always present when q > 0); q_psi < q is non-associated and q_psi = 0 gives no plastic volume change.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente q_psi que sustituye a q en el potencial plástico de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) + q_psi I1/3 = cte y controla el cambio de volumen plástico. q_psi = q da el flujo asociado de Drucker y Prager (siempre hay dilatancia si q > 0); q_psi < q es no asociado y q_psi = 0 no produce cambio de volumen plástico.
parameters.range_en: 0 to q (peak or residual q).
parameters.range_es: De 0 a q (q de pico o residual).
parameters.locator: RSData DP manual eq. 0.2 (p. 1: q_psi <= q_phi); Drucker & Prager 1952 eqs. 3-5 (p. 158: associated flow, plastic dilatation 3 alpha lambda); Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.4 p. 15-16 (friction much greater than dilatancy, so non-associated flow is needed).
parameters.notes: Dimensionless. Same registry key as in hoek_brown but a different quantity (see next entry).

parameters.definition_en: Parameter m_psi that replaces m in the Hoek-Brown plastic potential and controls plastic volume change. m_psi = m (mb) gives associated flow, m_psi < m non-associated, and m_psi = 0 no plastic volume change.
parameters.definition_es: Parámetro m_psi que sustituye a m en el potencial plástico de Hoek-Brown y controla el cambio de volumen plástico. m_psi = m (mb) da flujo asociado, m_psi < m no asociado y m_psi = 0 sin cambio de volumen plástico.
parameters.range_en: 0 to m (mb).
parameters.range_es: De 0 a m (mb).
parameters.locator: RSData HB/GHB manual eq. 0.7 (p. 2: m_psi <= m).
parameters.notes: Only the Rocscience manual defines it (kind: manual). It is NOT the same quantity as the Drucker-Prager dilation parameter (q_psi). RSData also shows a Dilation Parameter for GHB, which the OGR registry does not have.

parameters.definition_en: Poisson's ratio nu of the linear isotropic elastic response: minus the ratio of lateral to axial strain under uniaxial loading. With Young's modulus it fixes the shear modulus, G = E / (2(1 + nu)).
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de Poisson nu de la respuesta elástica lineal isótropa: cociente, cambiado de signo, entre la deformación lateral y la axial en carga uniaxial. Junto con el módulo de Young fija el módulo de corte, G = E / (2(1 + nu)).
parameters.range_en: Soils: 0-0.3; drained soils at working loads 0.1-0.2; saturated soil in undrained loading tends to 0.5. Intact rock: typically 0.25-0.4 (0.11-0.58 measured on 72 Canadian rocks).
parameters.range_es: Suelos: 0-0,3; suelos drenados en cargas de servicio 0,1-0,2; el suelo saturado en carga no drenada tiende a 0,5. Roca intacta: normalmente 0,25-0,4 (0,11-0,58 medidos en 72 rocas canadienses).
parameters.locator: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.1 p. 11 (soils 0.0-0.3; concrete 0.15-0.2); GEC 5 §5.5.3 p. 151 (0.1-0.2, citing Jamiolkowski et al. 1994) and §6.4.1 p. 205 (rock 0.25-0.4) with Table 41; UFC 3-220-01N eq. 12-21 p. 12-18 (G = E/(2(1+nu)); saturated soils nu = 0.5); CANMET 1995 Table 1 column nu (PDF pp. 102-109), min 0.11 (mudstone) to max 0.58 (talc-carbonate), computed from the table.
parameters.notes: Shown in the Linear Isotropic and the Cam-Clay (Constant Poisson Ratio) stiffness. CANMET prints 0.58 for talc-carbonate (checked on the page image), above the 0.5 isotropic limit; the program limits nu to < 0.5.

parameters.definition_en: Young's modulus E of the linear isotropic elastic response: ratio of axial stress to axial strain under uniaxial loading, before yield.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de Young E de la respuesta elástica lineal isótropa: cociente entre la tensión axial y la deformación axial en carga uniaxial, antes de la plastificación.
parameters.range_en: Soils (equivalent modulus): 2,000-200,000 kPa, e.g. soft sensitive clay 2,500-15,000, dense sand 50,000-80,000, dense gravel 100,000-200,000 kPa. Intact rock: typically 0.1-100 GPa (1.8-166 GPa measured on 72 Canadian rocks).
parameters.range_es: Suelos (módulo equivalente): 2.000-200.000 kPa, p. ej. arcilla blanda sensible 2.500-15.000, arena densa 50.000-80.000 y grava densa 100.000-200.000 kPa. Roca intacta: normalmente 0,1-100 GPa (1,8-166 GPa medidos en 72 rocas canadienses).
parameters.locator: Definition: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.1 p. 11 (Hooke's law, E and nu). Ranges: GEC 5 Table 28 p. 148 (modified after AASHTO 1996); GEC 5 §6.4.1 p. 205 (intact rock 0.1-100 GPa); CANMET 1995 Table 1 column E (PDF pp. 102-109), min 1.76 GPa (coal) to max 166.3 GPa (sulphide pyrite), computed from the table.
parameters.notes: Intact-rock values are not rock-mass values; the rock-mass modulus is much lower (the 'Erm' button fills it from Generalized Hoek-Brown). Vermeer & de Borst also state concrete 20-40 GPa, about a thousand times typical sand values.

parameters.definition_en: Chooses which elastic constant is held fixed in Cam-Clay, whose bulk modulus is not constant but grows with mean stress and specific volume (slope kappa of the swelling line). Constant Poisson Ratio: G changes with the bulk modulus; Constant Shear Modulus: G is fixed and nu changes.
parameters.definition_es: Elige qué constante elástica se mantiene fija en Cam-Clay, cuyo módulo volumétrico no es constante sino que crece con la tensión media y el volumen específico (pendiente kappa de la línea de descarga). Coeficiente de Poisson constante: G varía con el módulo volumétrico; módulo de corte constante: G es fijo y nu varía.
parameters.range_en: Options: Constant Poisson Ratio | Constant Shear Modulus
parameters.range_es: Opciones: Coeficiente de Poisson constante | Módulo de corte constante
parameters.locator: RSData Cam-Clay manual §8.4 (p. 5: bulk modulus depends on mean stress, specific volume and swelling slope; either G or nu must be given) and Figs. 8.5-8.6 (constant nu vs constant G). Relation K = 2(1+nu)G / (3(1-2nu)): Itasca NorSand page, Elastic Law.
parameters.notes: Software option (kind: manual). The statement that the non-fixed constant varies follows from K varying with stress while the other constant is fixed. The scientific discussion of the two choices (Zytynski et al. 1978) was not read (see pending).

parameters.definition_en: Elastic shear modulus G held constant in Cam-Clay when 'Constant Shear Modulus' is chosen: ratio of shear stress to elastic shear strain.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de corte elástico G que se mantiene constante en Cam-Clay al elegir «Módulo de corte constante»: cociente entre la tensión tangencial y la deformación angular elástica.
parameters.range_en: Small-strain values: soft clays 2,750-13,750 kPa; firm clays 6,900-34,500 kPa (silty sands 27,600-138,000; dense sands and gravels 69,000-345,000 kPa).
parameters.range_es: Valores a pequeñas deformaciones: arcillas blandas 2.750-13.750 kPa; arcillas firmes 6.900-34.500 kPa (arenas limosas 27.600-138.000; arenas densas y gravas 69.000-345.000 kPa).
parameters.locator: RSData Cam-Clay manual §8.4 p. 5; UFC 3-220-01N eq. 12-21 p. 12-18 (G = E / (2(1+nu))); GEC 5 Table 30 p. 154.
parameters.notes: GEC 5 Table 30 gives small-strain (maximum) G0; GEC 5 §5.5.6 says it must be reduced for the larger strains of foundation loading, so operational values are lower.

parameters.definition_en: Elastic shear modulus at the reference mean stress p_ref in the NorSand power law G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de corte elástico a la tensión media de referencia p_ref en la ley potencial de NorSand G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m.
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law', Case 1; RSData NorSand Fraser River sand tutorial, Stiffness tab (40000 kPa at p_ref = 395 kPa).
parameters.notes: Only software manuals state the law (kind: manual); Jefferies & Been (2015) is cited by Itasca but was not read. GEC 5 Table 30 small-strain G0 values are at in situ stress, not at p_ref, so they were not used as a range.

parameters.definition_en: Reference mean effective stress at which the shear modulus equals G_ref in G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m.
parameters.definition_es: Tensión media efectiva de referencia a la que el módulo de corte vale G_ref en G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m.
parameters.range_en: Usually 100 kPa (about atmospheric pressure).
parameters.range_es: Normalmente 100 kPa (del orden de la presión atmosférica).
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law' and property 'pressure-reference' (default 100 kPa, should match atmospheric pressure); RSData tutorial uses 395 kPa.
parameters.notes: Software manual only (kind: manual).

parameters.definition_en: Exponent m of the stress dependence of the shear modulus, G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m. m = 0 gives a constant G and m = 1 a G proportional to mean stress (constant rigidity G_ref/p_ref).
parameters.definition_es: Exponente m de la dependencia del módulo de corte con la tensión, G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m. m = 0 da G constante y m = 1 un G proporcional a la tensión media (rigidez G_ref/p_ref constante).
parameters.range_en: 0 to 1; 0.5 in the Hardin & Drnevich (1972) and Seed & Idriss (1971) small-strain correlations for soils.
parameters.range_es: De 0 a 1; 0,5 en las correlaciones a pequeñas deformaciones de Hardin y Drnevich (1972) y Seed e Idriss (1971) para suelos.
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law' (0 <= m <= 1); UFC 3-220-01N eqs. 12-23 and 12-24, pp. 12-19 to 12-20 (G proportional to sigma'0^0.5); RSData tutorial m = 0.47 (Fraser River sand).
parameters.notes: Hardin & Drnevich 1972 and Seed & Idriss 1971 read only as reproduced in UFC 3-220-01N.

parameters.definition_en: Poisson's ratio used by NorSand to obtain the elastic bulk modulus from the current shear modulus, K = 2(1 + nu) G / (3(1 - 2 nu)).
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de Poisson que usa NorSand para obtener el módulo volumétrico elástico a partir del módulo de corte actual, K = 2(1 + nu) G / (3(1 - 2 nu)).
parameters.range_en: Drained soils at working loads 0.1-0.2; soils in general 0-0.3.
parameters.range_es: Suelos drenados en cargas de servicio 0,1-0,2; suelos en general 0-0,3.
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law' (K from G and nu; default 0.2); GEC 5 §5.5.3 p. 151; Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.1 p. 11; RSData tutorial 0.15.
parameters.notes: Same physical quantity as 'poisson', in the NorSand stiffness group.

parameters.definition_en: Lower limit of the elastic shear modulus, so that G does not fall to zero when the mean stress approaches zero.
parameters.definition_es: Límite inferior del módulo de corte elástico, para que G no se anule cuando la tensión media tiende a cero.
parameters.locator: RSData NorSand Fraser River sand tutorial, Stiffness tab: 'Minimum Shear Modulus (kPa) = 1'.
parameters.notes: No document defines it: the definition is read from the RSData field label and the power law (G -> 0 as p' -> 0 when m > 0). Itasca's NorSand page has no such limit. Listed in pending.

parameters.definition_en: Uniaxial compressive strength σci of the intact rock pieces (laboratory scale), the stress that scales the Hoek-Brown envelope.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión simple σci de la roca intacta (escala de probeta), tensión que escala la envolvente de Hoek-Brown.
parameters.range_en: 0.25 to >250 MPa (grades R0 extremely weak to R6 extremely strong)
parameters.range_es: 0,25 a >250 MPa (grados R0 extremadamente débil a R6 extremadamente resistente)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 1 and its definitions; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, Fig. 1 (field estimates of UCS, grades after Brown 1981), PDF p. 93
parameters.notes: Same meaning as 'sigci' of Generalized Hoek-Brown. Program unit kPa: the range is 250 to >250000 kPa. The range is the span of the grade table already in ogr_data/data/rock_strength_grades.json.

parameters.definition_en: Hoek-Brown constant m of the rock mass, entered directly; it controls the curvature and frictional part of the envelope (equal to mi for intact rock, lower for jointed rock).
parameters.definition_es: Constante m de Hoek-Brown del macizo rocoso, introducida directamente; controla la curvatura y la parte friccional de la envolvente (igual a mi en roca intacta, menor en roca diaclasada).
parameters.range_en: 0 < mb ≤ mi (mb = mi for intact rock)
parameters.range_es: 0 < mb ≤ mi (mb = mi en roca intacta)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 1 (original criterion, constant m) and eq. 3 (mb = mi·exp((GSI-100)/(28-14D)), whose factor is ≤ 1 for GSI ≤ 100)
parameters.notes: In this model the exponent is fixed at a = 0.5 (original criterion, Hoek et al. 2002 eq. 1). The bound mb ≤ mi follows from eq. 3; no source gives a numeric typical range for mb itself.

parameters.definition_en: Hoek-Brown constant s of the rock mass, entered directly; it expresses how fractured the mass is and sets its uniaxial and tensile strength.
parameters.definition_es: Constante s de Hoek-Brown del macizo rocoso, introducida directamente; expresa el grado de fracturación y fija la resistencia a compresión simple y a tracción del macizo.
parameters.range_en: 0 < s ≤ 1 (s = 1 for intact rock)
parameters.range_es: 0 < s ≤ 1 (s = 1 en roca intacta)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, definitions after eq. 1 (s = 1 for intact rock) and eq. 4
parameters.notes: In this model the exponent is fixed at a = 0.5.

parameters.definition_en: Value of mb used after failure (post-peak residual strength); only active when residual is not set to peak.
parameters.definition_es: Valor de mb tras la rotura (resistencia residual postpico); solo se usa si el residual no se iguala al pico.
parameters.locator: RSData Theory ch. 6, p. 2 (peak and residual values of all properties)
parameters.notes: Definition from the Rocscience manual only. No source read gives typical residual values; see pending list.

parameters.definition_en: Value of s used after failure (post-peak residual strength); only active when residual is not set to peak.
parameters.definition_es: Valor de s tras la rotura (resistencia residual postpico); solo se usa si el residual no se iguala al pico.
parameters.locator: RSData Theory ch. 6, p. 2
parameters.notes: Definition from the Rocscience manual only. No source read gives typical residual values; see pending list.

parameters.definition_en: How the rock mass constants mb, s and a are obtained. With 'GSI' (the only option here) they are computed from GSI, mi and D.
parameters.definition_es: Modo de obtener las constantes del macizo mb, s y a. Con 'GSI' (única opción aquí) se calculan a partir de GSI, mi y D.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eqs. 3, 4 and 5
parameters.notes: Selector of the RSData dialog; no Rocscience text describing its other options was found (see pending list). The equations behind the 'GSI' option are sourced.

parameters.definition_en: Uniaxial compressive strength σci of the intact rock pieces (laboratory scale); one of the three basic inputs of the criterion with mi and GSI.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión simple σci de la roca intacta (escala de probeta); uno de los tres datos básicos del criterio junto con mi y GSI.
parameters.range_en: 0.25 to >250 MPa (grades R0 extremely weak to R6 extremely strong)
parameters.range_es: 0,25 a >250 MPa (grados R0 extremadamente débil a R6 extremadamente resistente)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eqs. 1-2; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, list of the three required properties (PDF p. 92) and Fig. 1 (PDF p. 93)
parameters.notes: Program unit kPa: 250 to >250000 kPa. Range = span of ogr_data/data/rock_strength_grades.json. Hoek 2023 (PDF p. 92) warns that for foliated rocks the choice of σci is uncertain because it depends on loading direction.

parameters.definition_en: Geological Strength Index: a rating of the rock mass from its structure (interlocking of blocks) and the condition of discontinuity surfaces, used to reduce intact-rock properties to rock-mass values.
parameters.definition_es: Índice de resistencia geológica: valoración del macizo rocoso según su estructura (trabazón de bloques) y el estado de las superficies de las discontinuidades, con la que se reducen las propiedades de la roca intacta a las del macizo.
parameters.range_en: About 10 (laminated/sheared, very poor surfaces) to 90 (intact or massive, very good surfaces) on the chart; quote a range rather than a single value
parameters.range_es: Aproximadamente 10 (laminado/cizallado, superficies muy malas) a 90 (intacto o masivo, superficies muy buenas) en el ábaco; mejor dar un intervalo que un valor único
parameters.locator: Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, 'Geological Strength Index' and Fig. 6 (GSI chart after Hoek and Marinos 2000), PDF pp. 98-99; Marinos & Hoek 2000, section 3 and Tables 5-13 (typical GSI ranges by rock type); Hoek et al. 2013, eq. 1 (GSI = 1.5 JCond89 + RQD/2)
parameters.notes: Range read from the contour labels of the chart. The chart text advises quoting e.g. 33-37 rather than 35. GSI = 100 corresponds to intact rock (s = 1 with D = 0, Hoek et al. 2002 eq. 4); the program accepts 1-100. GSI should not be estimated from RMR (Hoek 2023, PDF p. 98) and is not applicable to structurally controlled failures.

parameters.definition_en: Hoek-Brown material constant of the intact rock, related to its frictional properties; it depends on rock type, texture and mineralogy.
parameters.definition_es: Constante de material de Hoek-Brown de la roca intacta, ligada a sus propiedades friccionales; depende del tipo de roca, la textura y la mineralogía.
parameters.range_en: About 4 (claystones) to 32 (granite)
parameters.range_es: Aproximadamente 4 (argilitas) a 32 (granito)
parameters.locator: Hoek, Practical Rock Engineering ch. 11, Table 3 (values of mi by rock group), p. 6; Marinos & Hoek 2000, section 2.0 and Table 2
parameters.notes: Range = minimum and maximum of ogr_data/data/mi_values.json (taken from that Table 3). Values in parentheses in the source are estimates; conglomerates and breccias can vary widely; foliated-rock values are for loading normal to foliation (Marinos & Hoek 2000, Table 2 footnotes).

parameters.definition_en: Disturbance factor D: degree of damage of the rock mass by blasting and stress relaxation; it reduces mb, s and the rock mass modulus.
parameters.definition_es: Factor de alteración D: grado de daño del macizo por voladuras y relajación de tensiones; reduce mb, s y el módulo de deformación del macizo.
parameters.range_en: 0 (undisturbed in situ rock mass) to 1 (very disturbed); guideline values 0, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8 and 1.0
parameters.range_es: 0 (macizo in situ inalterado) a 1 (muy alterado); valores orientativos 0; 0,5; 0,7; 0,8 y 1,0
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, text after eq. 5 and section 7, Table 1; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, PDF p. 102 and Fig. 9 (PDF p. 103); Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eqs. 2 and 4 and section 7
parameters.notes: Hoek 2023 (PDF p. 102) stresses that D applies only to the blast-damaged zone (typically 1-2 m around a tunnel), modelled as a separate weaker material, not to the whole rock mass. Guideline values are those of ogr_data/data/disturbance_factor.json.

parameters.definition_en: Young's modulus Ei of the intact rock; used only by the Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) method to estimate the rock mass modulus. If not measured it can be estimated as Ei = MR·σci.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de Young Ei de la roca intacta; solo lo usa el método Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) para estimar el módulo del macizo. Si no se ha medido puede estimarse como Ei = MR·σci.
parameters.range_en: Ei/σci = MR ≈ 150 to 1100 depending on rock type
parameters.range_es: Ei/σci = MR ≈ 150 a 1100 según el tipo de roca
parameters.locator: Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eq. 3 and Table 3 (p. 210); Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, eq. 21 and Fig. 13 (PDF pp. 108-110)
parameters.notes: Range of MR derived from ogr_data/data/modulus_ratio.json (min and max of the table); not a range of Ei itself. Hoek & Diederichs note that measured Ei is often unreliable because of specimen damage, so MR·σci is usually preferred.

parameters.definition_en: Empirical equation used to estimate the rock mass deformation modulus Erm: Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) uses Ei, GSI and D; Simplified Hoek & Diederichs (2006) uses GSI and D only; Hoek, Carranza-Torres & Corkum (2002) uses σci, GSI and D.
parameters.definition_es: Ecuación empírica para estimar el módulo de deformación del macizo Erm: Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) usa Ei, GSI y D; Simplified Hoek & Diederichs (2006) solo GSI y D; Hoek, Carranza-Torres & Corkum (2002) usa σci, GSI y D.
parameters.locator: Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eq. 2 (simplified, p. 208), eq. 4 (generalized, p. 209), section 6 (recommendation, p. 209) and Table 1 eq. 7 (2002 equation, σci ≤ 100 MPa, p. 204); Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 11; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, eqs. 20 and 22 (PDF p. 108)
parameters.notes: Hoek & Diederichs recommend eq. 4 with Ei = MR·σci when σci is known, and the simplified eq. 2 when reliable intact data are not available (its D = 0 curve is an upper bound). In the 2002 equation σci is limited to 100 MPa (Hoek & Diederichs 2006 Table 1; Marinos & Hoek 2000 spreadsheet, Table 4).

parameters.definition_en: GSI used to compute the residual (post-peak) mb, s and a; only active when residual is not set to peak.
parameters.definition_es: GSI con el que se calculan mb, s y a residuales (postpico); solo se usa si el residual no se iguala al pico.
parameters.locator: RSData Theory ch. 6, p. 2 (peak and residual values of all properties)
parameters.notes: Definition from the Rocscience manual. No source read gives guidance on residual GSI values; see pending list.

parameters.definition_en: mi used to compute the residual (post-peak) strength parameters; only active when residual is not set to peak.
parameters.definition_es: mi con el que se calculan los parámetros resistentes residuales (postpico); solo se usa si el residual no se iguala al pico.
parameters.locator: RSData Theory ch. 6, p. 2
parameters.notes: Definition from the Rocscience manual. No residual-specific range found; see pending list.

parameters.definition_en: Disturbance factor D used to compute the residual (post-peak) strength parameters; only active when residual is not set to peak.
parameters.definition_es: Factor de alteración D con el que se calculan los parámetros resistentes residuales (postpico); solo se usa si el residual no se iguala al pico.
parameters.range_en: 0 to 1
parameters.locator: RSData Theory ch. 6, p. 2; bounds of D from Hoek et al. 2002, text after eq. 5
parameters.notes: The 0-1 bound is the definition range of D; no guidance specific to residual D was found.

parameters.definition_en: Option for a tension cutoff σ3 = T on the envelope. With 'None' (the only option here) no cutoff is added and the tensile limit is the criterion's own, σt = -s·σci/mb.
parameters.definition_es: Opción de corte a tracción σ3 = T sobre la envolvente. Con 'None' (única opción aquí) no se añade corte y el límite a tracción es el propio del criterio, σt = -s·σci/mb.
parameters.locator: RSData Theory ch. 6, p. 5, eqs. 0.8-0.10 (tension cutoff, Tmax = s·σci/m, Hoek & Martin 2014 alternative, user defined); Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 7
parameters.notes: Software option (kind manual). The meaning of 'None' is taken from the program code (core/simulation.py: 'Hoek-Brown family: tensile strength inherent to the criterion'), not from a manual. RSData offers more options (Hoek & Martin 2014, user defined) that this program does not.

parameters.definition_en: Upper limit of the minor principal stress σ3 of the range over which the equivalent Mohr-Coulomb line is fitted to the curved envelope; it changes c and φ but not the parameters of the curved criterion.
parameters.definition_es: Límite superior de la tensión principal menor σ3 del intervalo en que se ajusta la recta de Mohr-Coulomb equivalente a la envolvente curva; cambia c y φ pero no los parámetros del criterio curvo.
parameters.range_en: Must be set case by case; earlier guidance: 0.25·σci for tunnels deeper than 30 m, σv = depth × unit weight for shallow tunnels and slopes
parameters.range_es: Debe fijarse en cada caso; criterio anterior: 0,25·σci para túneles a más de 30 m, σv = profundidad × peso específico para túneles someros y taludes
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 4 (fit over σt < σ3 < σ3max, eqs. 12-13) and section 6; Marinos & Hoek 2000, sections 2.1 and 2.2; RocData User's Guide, 'Failure Envelope Range' (no effect on the non-linear parameters)
parameters.notes: In 'Custom' mode the user types it; in Tunnel/Slope mode it is computed (see 'application'). RocData also offers a 'General' option σ3max = σci/4 that this program lacks. For block caving Hoek et al. 2002 advise not relating Hoek-Brown and Mohr-Coulomb at all.

parameters.definition_en: How σ3max is set: Custom (typed by the user), Tunnel (σ3max/σ'cm = 0.47(σ'cm/γH)^-0.94, gives equivalent ground reaction curves) or Slope (σ3max/σ'cm = 0.72(σ'cm/γH)^-0.91, gives equivalent factor of safety and failure surface).
parameters.definition_es: Modo de fijar σ3max: Custom (lo escribe el usuario), Tunnel (σ3max/σ'cm = 0,47(σ'cm/γH)^-0,94, da curvas características equivalentes) o Slope (σ3max/σ'cm = 0,72(σ'cm/γH)^-0,91, da coeficiente de seguridad y superficie de rotura equivalentes).
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 6, eqs. 18 (tunnels) and 19 (slopes), Fig. 2; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, eqs. 17-18, PDF pp. 106-107
parameters.notes: Tunnel equation valid for deep and shallow tunnels (depth < 3 diameters) as long as caving to surface is avoided; slope equation from Bishop circular failure analyses. Only for the Hoek-Brown family in this program (core/material_results.py HB_FAMILY).

parameters.definition_en: Unit weight γ of the rock mass, used with the depth or height H to form the overburden stress γH in the σ3max equations.
parameters.definition_es: Peso específico γ del macizo rocoso, que con la profundidad o altura H da la tensión de recubrimiento γH en las ecuaciones de σ3max.
parameters.range_en: Typically about 0.027 MN/m³ (2.7 t/m³)
parameters.range_es: Típicamente unos 0,027 MN/m³ (2,7 t/m³)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, definitions after eq. 18; Hoek 2023, In situ and induced stresses, 'In situ stresses', PDF p. 133
parameters.notes: Program unit for this field is MN/m³ (not kN/m³), so γH comes out in MPa. The 0.027 MN/m³ is a single typical value stated by Hoek, not a range.

parameters.definition_en: Depth H of the tunnel below the ground surface, used in the tunnel σ3max equation.
parameters.definition_es: Profundidad H del túnel bajo la superficie, usada en la ecuación de σ3max para túneles.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 6, eq. 18 and following text
parameters.notes: Same widget as 'slope_height' (relabelled by mode). Hoek et al. 2002 say that if the horizontal stress exceeds the vertical one, the horizontal stress should replace γH; this program has no input for that case.

parameters.definition_en: Height H of the slope, used in the slope σ3max equation.
parameters.definition_es: Altura H del talud, usada en la ecuación de σ3max para taludes.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 6, eq. 19
parameters.notes: Same widget as 'tunnel_depth' (relabelled by mode).

parameters.definition_en: Computed Hoek-Brown constant of the rock mass: mi reduced according to GSI and D.
parameters.definition_es: Constante de Hoek-Brown del macizo calculada: mi reducida según GSI y D.
parameters.range_en: 0 < mb ≤ mi
parameters.range_es: 0 < mb ≤ mi
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 3
parameters.notes: Result row 'mb' of the results panel. Bound follows from eq. 3.

parameters.definition_en: Computed rock mass constant s from GSI and D; it falls from 1 for intact rock as the mass becomes more fractured or disturbed.
parameters.definition_es: Constante s del macizo calculada a partir de GSI y D; baja desde 1 en roca intacta a medida que el macizo está más fracturado o alterado.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 4 and definitions after eq. 1
parameters.notes: Result row 's'.

parameters.definition_en: Computed exponent a of the generalized criterion, a function of GSI only; it replaces the 0.5 of the original criterion.
parameters.definition_es: Exponente a calculado del criterio generalizado, función solo de GSI; sustituye al 0,5 del criterio original.
parameters.range_en: From 0.5 (GSI = 100) to about 0.67 (very low GSI)
parameters.range_es: De 0,5 (GSI = 100) a unos 0,67 (GSI muy bajo)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 5
parameters.notes: Range evaluated from eq. 5 at its limits (GSI = 100 and GSI → 0), not stated in words by the source.

parameters.definition_en: Tensile strength of the rock mass, σt = -s·σci/mb, obtained for equal biaxial tension; for brittle rock it is taken equal to the uniaxial tensile strength.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a tracción del macizo, σt = -s·σci/mb, obtenida en tracción biaxial igual; en roca frágil se toma igual a la resistencia a tracción uniaxial.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 7 and following text
parameters.notes: Shown negative (tension negative). Result row 'sigt'.

parameters.definition_en: Uniaxial compressive strength of the rock mass, σc = σci·s^a (criterion at σ3 = 0); failure starts at an excavation boundary when it is exceeded.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión simple del macizo, σc = σci·s^a (criterio con σ3 = 0); la rotura se inicia en el contorno de la excavación cuando se supera.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 6 and section 5
parameters.notes: Result row 'sigc'.

parameters.definition_en: Global rock mass strength σ'cm: the overall strength of the mass (e.g. a pillar), from a Mohr-Coulomb fit over σt < σ3 < σci/4; it is also the input of the tunnel and slope σ3max equations.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia global del macizo σ'cm: resistencia de conjunto del macizo (p. ej. un pilar), a partir de un ajuste de Mohr-Coulomb en σt < σ3 < σci/4; es también el dato de las ecuaciones de σ3max para túneles y taludes.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 5, eqs. 16-17
parameters.notes: Does not depend on σ3max. For classic Hoek-Brown it is computed with a = 0.5.

parameters.definition_en: Equivalent Mohr-Coulomb cohesion c': intercept of the straight line that balances the areas above and below the curved envelope over σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.definition_es: Cohesión equivalente de Mohr-Coulomb c': ordenada en el origen de la recta que equilibra las áreas por encima y por debajo de la envolvente curva en σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 4, eq. 13 (with σ3n = σ3max/σci)
parameters.notes: Depends strongly on σ3max. Hoek et al. 2002 apply it to the Hoek-Brown family; other criteria in the program are fitted by other means (other groups).

parameters.definition_en: Equivalent Mohr-Coulomb friction angle φ': slope of the straight line fitted to the curved envelope over σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de rozamiento equivalente de Mohr-Coulomb φ': pendiente de la recta ajustada a la envolvente curva en σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 4, eq. 12
parameters.notes: Depends strongly on σ3max. Example in Hoek et al. 2002 section 7: σci 50 MPa, mi 10, GSI 45 gives φ' = 47.16° (tunnel 100 m deep, D = 0) and 27.61° (slope 100 m high, D = 1).

parameters.definition_en: Rock mass deformation modulus Erm estimated with the selected Erm method from GSI, D and, depending on the method, Ei or σci.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de deformación del macizo Erm estimado con el método elegido a partir de GSI, D y, según el método, Ei o σci.
parameters.locator: Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eqs. 2 and 4; Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 11
parameters.notes: Result row 'Erm'. The 100000 in the simplified equation is a scaling constant, not a physical modulus (Hoek & Diederichs 2006, p. 208).

parameters.definition_en: M, the slope of the critical state line in the p'-q plane (q = M p'): the stress ratio at which the soil keeps shearing at constant stress and constant volume. In Cam-Clay and Modified Cam-Clay it also fixes the shape of the yield surface, whose peak q lies on this line.
parameters.definition_es: M, pendiente de la línea de estado crítico en el plano p'-q (q = M p'): relación de tensiones con la que el suelo sigue deformándose por corte a tensión y volumen constantes. En Cam-Clay y Cam-Clay Modificado fija además la forma de la superficie de fluencia, cuyo máximo de q está sobre esa línea.
parameters.range_en: 0.845-1.02 for five remoulded clays (Klein Belt Ton, Wiener Tegel V, London, Weald, kaolin); equivalent friction angles 21.75-26 deg
parameters.range_es: 0,845-1,02 en cinco arcillas remoldeadas (Klein Belt Ton, Wiener Tegel V, Londres, Weald, caolín); ángulos de rozamiento equivalentes 21,75-26°
parameters.locator: Schofield & Wroth 1968, §5.9 eq. (5.22) p. 73, §6.8 p. 104, Table 6.1 p. 109, eq. (8.9) p. 151 (q/p = 6 sin ρ / (3 − sin ρ) in triaxial compression); Rocscience ch. 8, §8.2 and §8.3 eqs. (0.5)-(0.6); UTM notes slides 17-18 (M = 6 sin φ'c / (3 − sin φ'c)).
parameters.notes: Dimensionless. The range is the set of laboratory values in Schofield & Wroth Table 6.1 (data of Hvorslev, Parry and Loudon), not a statistical range for all soils. The 6 sin φ/(3 − sin φ) relation holds for triaxial compression only (extension uses 3 + sin φ, Schofield & Wroth eq. (8.8)).

parameters.definition_en: Chooses which line the specific volume entered below refers to: N, the normal compression line at unit pressure, or Γ (Gamma), the critical state line at unit pressure. Only one is needed because the model links them: Γ = N − (λ − κ) in Cam-Clay and Γ = N − (λ − κ)·ln 2 in Modified Cam-Clay.
parameters.definition_es: Elige a qué línea se refiere el volumen específico que se introduce: N, la línea de compresión normal a presión unidad, o Γ (Gamma), la línea de estado crítico a presión unidad. Basta uno de los dos porque el modelo los relaciona: Γ = N − (λ − κ) en Cam-Clay y Γ = N − (λ − κ)·ln 2 en Cam-Clay Modificado.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 8, §8.2 eqs. (0.3) and (0.4); Schofield & Wroth 1968, eq. (6.20) p. 100 and eq. (7.18) p. 139 (for an isotropically normally compressed Cam-clay specimen the λ-line lies (λ − κ) above the critical state line, which is the Cam-Clay relation).
parameters.notes: Enum option (Normal Compression Line (N) / Critical State Line (Gamma)) is an RSData input convention. The Cam-Clay relation is in Schofield & Wroth; the Modified Cam-Clay relation (ln 2 factor) was only seen in the Rocscience manual; the original (Roscoe & Burland 1968) was not read.

parameters.definition_en: Specific volume v = 1 + e of the selected reference line (N for the normal compression line, Γ for the critical state line) at a mean effective stress of one pressure unit. It locates the line in the v-ln p' plane; its value depends on the pressure unit used.
parameters.definition_es: Volumen específico v = 1 + e de la línea de referencia elegida (N, línea de compresión normal; Γ, línea de estado crítico) para una tensión media efectiva igual a una unidad de presión. Sitúa la línea en el plano v-ln p'; su valor depende de la unidad de presión empleada.
parameters.range_en: Γ = 1.88-3.99 for five remoulded clays, with pressure in lb/in² (Schofield & Wroth Table 6.1); no table of N values found
parameters.range_es: Γ = 1,88-3,99 en cinco arcillas remoldeadas, con la presión en lb/in² (Schofield & Wroth, tabla 6.1); no se encontró tabla de valores de N
parameters.locator: Schofield & Wroth 1968, eq. (5.23) p. 73, Table 6.1 p. 109, text on Γ and units p. 111; Rocscience ch. 8, §8.1 eq. (0.1) and §8.2; UTM notes slides 14, 17 and 23.
parameters.notes: UNIT WARNING: Schofield & Wroth define unit pressure as 1 lb/in² and state that Γ changes with the pressure unit; the program works in kPa. From v = Γ − λ ln p, a value tabulated with p in lb/in² becomes Γ(kPa) = Γ(lb/in²) + λ·ln(6.895) (unit conversion derived by the integrator from eq. (5.23), not a value stated by the source). Do not show the Table 6.1 range without this caveat. The UTM worked example gets N = 2.58 (kPa) for one oedometer test (slide 16), a single example, not a range.

parameters.definition_en: κ, slope of the swelling (unloading-reloading) line in the v-ln p' plane. It governs the recoverable volume change; in these models the elastic bulk modulus is K = v p'/κ, so it grows with mean stress.
parameters.definition_es: κ, pendiente de la línea de hinchamiento (descarga-recarga) en el plano v-ln p'. Controla el cambio de volumen recuperable; en estos modelos el módulo volumétrico elástico es K = v p'/κ, que crece con la tensión media.
parameters.range_en: 0.026-0.184 (average κ of five remoulded clays); London clay 0.062 ± 0.016
parameters.range_es: 0,026-0,184 (κ medio de cinco arcillas remoldeadas); arcilla de Londres 0,062 ± 0,016
parameters.locator: Schofield & Wroth 1968, §4.2 p. 50, eq. (6.3) p. 94, §7.4 p. 120 (London clay), Table 6.1 p. 109; Rocscience ch. 8, §8.1 eq. (0.2) and §8.4 eq. (0.7); UTM notes slides 14 and 26 (κ = Cs/2.3).
parameters.notes: Dimensionless (natural logarithm). If only the oedometer swelling index Cs (base-10) is available, κ ≈ Cs/2.303 (UTM slide 26).

parameters.definition_en: λ, slope of the normal (virgin) compression line in the v-ln p' plane; the critical state line has the same slope. It measures the irrecoverable compressibility and controls the hardening of the yield surface with plastic volumetric strain.
parameters.definition_es: λ, pendiente de la línea de compresión normal (noval) en el plano v-ln p'; la línea de estado crítico tiene la misma pendiente. Mide la compresibilidad irrecuperable y controla el endurecimiento de la superficie de fluencia con la deformación volumétrica plástica.
parameters.range_en: 0.093-0.356 for five remoulded clays (kaolin 0.26, London clay 0.161, Weald clay 0.093)
parameters.range_es: 0,093-0,356 en cinco arcillas remoldeadas (caolín 0,26, arcilla de Londres 0,161, arcilla de Weald 0,093)
parameters.locator: Schofield & Wroth 1968, §4.2 p. 50, eq. (5.23) p. 73, Table 6.1 p. 109, eq. (6.33) p. 107 (λ ≈ 0.585·PI, PI as a ratio), eq. (6.38) p. 110 (Cc = 2.303 λ); Rocscience ch. 8, §8.1 eq. (0.1) and §8.6 eq. (0.8); UTM notes slides 14, 23 and 26.
parameters.notes: Dimensionless (natural logarithm). From an oedometer compression index Cc (base-10): λ ≈ Cc/2.303. Same key also exists in NorSand with a different meaning (CSL slope) - separate entry in that group.

parameters.definition_en: Chooses how the initial size of the yield surface is given: by the overconsolidation ratio (OCR) applied to the initial stresses, or directly by the preconsolidation pressure p0.
parameters.definition_es: Elige cómo se da el tamaño inicial de la superficie de fluencia: mediante el índice de sobreconsolidación (OCR) aplicado a las tensiones iniciales, o directamente con la presión de preconsolidación p0.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 8, §8.5 (initial yield surface set by assigning the preconsolidation pressure or the OCR); UTM notes slide 23.
parameters.notes: Software input option (RSData combo). The alternative OCR / p0 is stated in both sources; no scientific original needed for the choice itself.

parameters.definition_en: Overconsolidation ratio: preconsolidation pressure divided by the current mean effective stress. OCR = 1 is a normally consolidated soil (stress state on the yield surface); OCR > 1 is overconsolidated and starts inside the yield surface, responding elastically at first.
parameters.definition_es: Índice de sobreconsolidación: presión de preconsolidación dividida por la tensión media efectiva actual. OCR = 1 es un suelo normalmente consolidado (estado sobre la superficie de fluencia); OCR > 1 es sobreconsolidado, parte del interior de la superficie y responde al principio de forma elástica.
parameters.range_en: ≥ 1 (1 = normally consolidated, > 1 = overconsolidated)
parameters.range_es: ≥ 1 (1 = normalmente consolidado, > 1 = sobreconsolidado)
parameters.locator: Schofield & Wroth 1968, §7.10 p. 139, Fig. 7.25 and eqs. (7.16)-(7.18) ('overcompression ratio' N: compressed to N·p0 and swollen back to p0); Rocscience ch. 8, §8.5 and §8.7 (examples OCR = 2 lightly and OCR = 5 highly overconsolidated); UTM notes slide 23 (ratio of previous maximum mean stress to current mean stress).
parameters.notes: Defined in terms of mean (isotropic) effective stress, not the oedometer vertical-stress OCR. The range is the definitional bound; no source read gives typical field values.

parameters.definition_en: pc (p0), the largest mean effective stress the soil has carried; it is where the yield surface meets the p' axis and so sets its size. Plastic volumetric compression makes it grow (hardening) and dilation on the dry side makes it shrink (softening).
parameters.definition_es: pc (p0), la mayor tensión media efectiva que ha soportado el suelo; es el punto donde la superficie de fluencia corta el eje p' y fija su tamaño. La compresión volumétrica plástica lo aumenta (endurecimiento) y la dilatancia en el lado seco lo reduce (reblandecimiento).
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 8, §8.3 eqs. (0.5)-(0.6), §8.5, §8.6 eq. (0.8); Schofield & Wroth 1968, §7.10 p. 139 (virgin compression to N·p0).
parameters.notes: Site- and history-specific stress; no typical range applies. If initial stresses lie outside the surface, RS2/RS3 enlarge pc to fit them (Rocscience §8.5).

parameters.definition_en: Hardening law of the deviatoric cone. Hyperbolic: tan φ = tan φf·εq^p/(εq^p + A), a single extra parameter A; Tabular: user-given piecewise-linear friction angle and cohesion versus plastic deviatoric strain, which can also model softening.
parameters.definition_es: Ley de endurecimiento del cono desviador. Hiperbólica: tan φ = tan φf·εq^p/(εq^p + A), con un único parámetro adicional A; Tabular: ángulo de rozamiento y cohesión lineales a tramos frente a la deformación desviadora plástica, que permite también reblandecimiento.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.1 eq. (0.4) and following paragraphs; §11.1 last paragraph (tabular softening, mesh-dependence warning).
parameters.notes: The name 'Hyperbolic' is the RSData/RS2 option label (OGR-Data spec 013b); the manual describes the law by eq. (0.4) without that name. The manual warns that softening as a material law makes FE results mesh dependent.

parameters.definition_en: A, positive constant of the hyperbolic cone hardening law tan φ = tan φf·εq^p/(εq^p + A): the plastic deviatoric strain at which tan φ reaches half of tan φf. Smaller A gives faster hardening.
parameters.definition_es: A, constante positiva de la ley hiperbólica de endurecimiento del cono tan φ = tan φf·εq^p/(εq^p + A): la deformación desviadora plástica con la que tan φ alcanza la mitad de tan φf. Un A menor da un endurecimiento más rápido.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.1 eq. (0.4); calibrated examples A = 0.0038 (loose Hostun sand, Fig. 11.4) and A = 0.0036 (dense Hostun sand, Fig. 11.5).
parameters.notes: Dimensionless (strain). The 'half of tan φf' reading follows directly from eq. (0.4) with εq^p = A. Only two calibrated example values exist in the manual, not a range. Used only when Cone Hardening Type = Hyperbolic.

parameters.definition_en: Table for tabular cone hardening: plastic deviatoric strain εq^p with the mobilized friction angle and cohesion at that strain, interpolated linearly between rows. Decreasing values after a peak model softening.
parameters.definition_es: Tabla del endurecimiento tabular del cono: deformación desviadora plástica εq^p con el ángulo de rozamiento y la cohesión movilizados a esa deformación, interpolados linealmente entre filas. Valores decrecientes tras un máximo modelan reblandecimiento.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.1 (tabular law with pairs (εq^p, φ) and (εq^p, c)); §11.4 (dense Hostun sand with a tabular function to capture softening).
parameters.notes: Columns: Plastic Deviatoric Strain (dimensionless), Friction Angle (deg), Cohesion (stress). Used only when Cone Hardening Type = Tabular.

parameters.definition_en: With the Mohr-Coulomb cone dilation type it is ψf, the dilation angle at failure; the dilation used during hardening is ψf·φ/φf. With the Compaction-Dilation type it is the angle ψ that separates plastic compaction (mobilized φ < ψ) from dilation (φ > ψ).
parameters.definition_es: Con el tipo de dilatancia Mohr-Coulomb es ψf, el ángulo de dilatancia en rotura; durante el endurecimiento se usa ψf·φ/φf. Con el tipo Compactación-Dilatancia es el ángulo ψ que separa la compactación plástica (φ movilizado < ψ) de la dilatancia (φ > ψ).
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.1 eqs. (0.5)-(0.7); calibrated examples ψ = 33.5° with φf = 35° (loose Hostun sand, Fig. 11.4) and ψ = 30° with φf = 43.5° (dense Hostun sand, Fig. 11.5), both with the compaction-dilation option.
parameters.notes: Meaning changes with cone_dilation_type; the tooltip should show the sentence for the active option. Only example values in the source.

parameters.definition_en: Plastic potential of the deviatoric cone. Mohr-Coulomb: dilation grows with the mobilized friction up to ψf at failure; Compaction-Dilation: a Cam-Clay-like potential that compacts while the mobilized friction is below ψ and dilates above it.
parameters.definition_es: Potencial plástico del cono desviador. Mohr-Coulomb: la dilatancia crece con el rozamiento movilizado hasta ψf en rotura; Compactación-Dilatancia: potencial tipo Cam-Clay que compacta mientras el rozamiento movilizado es menor que ψ y dilata por encima.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.1 eqs. (0.5)-(0.6) (first option) and eq. (0.7) (second option).
parameters.notes: Software option. OGR-Data default is 'Mohr-Coulomb', but the RSData project export in Ejemplos\RSData_analisis\exportes\verificacion_rutas_estados.rsdata shows <ConeIsCompactDilation>true</ConeIsCompactDilation> for the default Softening-Hardening material: the integrator may want to check the default.

parameters.definition_en: Optional volumetric yield surface (cap) that closes the elastic region on the p' axis and models compaction. None: cone only; Vertical: a straight cap at p' = pc; Elliptical: a Modified-Cam-Clay-like ellipse offset by the cohesion, whose apex follows the ultimate shear surface.
parameters.definition_es: Superficie de fluencia volumétrica opcional (capa o cap) que cierra la región elástica sobre el eje p' y modela la compactación. None: solo el cono; Vertical: capa recta en p' = pc; Elíptica: elipse similar a la de Cam-Clay Modificado desplazada por la cohesión, cuyo vértice sigue a la superficie de corte última.
parameters.notes: Software option; the cap has an associated flow rule (§11.2).

parameters.definition_en: Hardening law of the cap pressure pc with plastic volumetric strain. Cam-Clay: built-in exponential law pc(n+1) = pc(n)·exp(Δεv^p/λ), with λ the Lambda Kappa input; Tabular: user-given piecewise-linear pc versus plastic volumetric strain.
parameters.definition_es: Ley de endurecimiento de la presión de capa pc con la deformación volumétrica plástica. Cam-Clay: ley exponencial incorporada pc(n+1) = pc(n)·exp(Δεv^p/λ), con λ el dato Lambda Kappa; Tabular: pc lineal a tramos frente a la deformación volumétrica plástica.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.2 eq. (0.10) and following paragraph.
parameters.notes: Software option; only meaningful when Cap Type is not None. The RSData export stores it as <CapIsExponential>.

parameters.definition_en: Parameter λ of the built-in (Cam-Clay) cap hardening law pc(n+1) = pc(n)·exp(Δεv^p/λ); the manual describes it as the difference between the slopes of the normal consolidation line and the swelling line (λ − κ). Larger values give slower growth of the cap.
parameters.definition_es: Parámetro λ de la ley incorporada (Cam-Clay) de endurecimiento de la capa pc(n+1) = pc(n)·exp(Δεv^p/λ); el manual lo describe como la diferencia entre las pendientes de la línea de consolidación normal y de la línea de hinchamiento (λ − κ). Valores mayores hacen crecer la capa más despacio.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.2 eq. (0.10).
parameters.notes: Unlike the Cam-Clay hardening law (Rocscience ch. 8, eq. (0.8): exp(v·Δεv^p/(λ − κ))), eq. (0.10) has no specific volume v, so the value the program expects may be (λ − κ)/v rather than (λ − κ); the manual does not say. This is the integrator's observation, not a sourced statement: keep the tooltip to the manual's wording. Used only with Cap Hardening Type = Cam-Clay and a cap active; default 0 would make eq. (0.10) undefined.

parameters.definition_en: Table for tabular cap hardening: plastic volumetric strain εv^p with the cap pressure pc at that strain, interpolated linearly. Allows other cap laws, such as those of the Hardening Soil or CySoil models.
parameters.definition_es: Tabla del endurecimiento tabular de la capa: deformación volumétrica plástica εv^p con la presión de capa pc a esa deformación, interpolada linealmente. Permite otras leyes de capa, como las de los modelos Hardening Soil o CySoil.
parameters.locator: Rocscience ch. 11, §11.2 (tabular law with pairs (εv^p, pc)).
parameters.notes: Columns: Plastic Volumetric Strain (dimensionless), Cap Pressure pc (stress). Used only with Cap Hardening Type = Tabular.

parameters.definition_en: Critical friction ratio: the stress ratio q/p' reached at the critical state, taken in triaxial compression as the reference condition. It sets the critical-state strength of the soil (it varies with Lode angle away from triaxial compression).
parameters.definition_es: Razón de rozamiento crítica: cociente de tensiones q/p' en el estado crítico, tomado en compresión triaxial como condición de referencia. Fija la resistencia en estado crítico del suelo (varía con el ángulo de Lode fuera de la compresión triaxial).
parameters.range_en: 1.2-1.5 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 1,2-1,5 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, symbol M) and Table 2 'NorSand soil properties with typical range for sands' (p. 78)
parameters.notes: Fraser River sand value in Table 2: 1.45 (the RSData tutorial uses 1.47).

parameters.definition_en: Slope of the critical state line (CSL) in void ratio versus natural logarithm of mean effective stress, e_c = Gamma - lambda ln(p'). It measures how much the critical void ratio falls as the stress level rises.
parameters.definition_es: Pendiente de la línea de estado crítico (LEC) en el plano índice de poros - logaritmo natural de la tensión media efectiva, e_c = Gamma - lambda ln(p'). Mide cuánto baja el índice de poros crítico al aumentar el nivel de tensiones.
parameters.range_en: 0.03-0.15 when defined on base 10 (lambda_10); about 0.013-0.065 in natural log (lambda_10 ~ 2.3 lambda_e)
parameters.range_es: 0,03-0,15 en base 10 (lambda_10); del orden de 0,013-0,065 en logaritmo natural (lambda_10 ~ 2,3 lambda_e)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67: lambda_e, lambda_10, 'lambda_10 ~ 2.3 lambda_e'), Table 1 (p. 77, e_c = Gamma - lambda ln(p')), Table 2 (p. 78, lambda_10 range for sands). The natural-log range is the Table 2 range divided by 2.3 (conversion given in the same paper).
parameters.notes: The source's typical range is base 10; the program's field is natural log, so the tooltip must show the converted range or say the base. Consistency check: Fraser River sand lambda_10 = 0.138 (Table 2) gives lambda_e = 0.06, the value of the RSData tutorial and the program default.

parameters.definition_en: Altitude of the critical state line: the void ratio on the CSL at a mean effective stress of 1 kPa. Together with lambda it fixes the critical void ratio at any stress level.
parameters.definition_es: Altura de la línea de estado crítico: índice de poros sobre la LEC para una tensión media efectiva de 1 kPa. Junto con lambda fija el índice de poros crítico a cualquier nivel de tensiones.
parameters.range_en: 0.9-1.4 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 0,9-1,4 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, symbol Gamma: reference void ratio on CSL at p' = 1 kPa) and Table 2 (p. 78)
parameters.notes: Dimensionless (a void ratio). The reference stress 1 kPa is part of the definition, consistent with the program's kPa units.

parameters.definition_en: Plastic hardening modulus at zero state parameter: the dimensionless modulus that controls how fast the yield surface grows with plastic shear strain, with H = H0 - Hy psi. It is calibrated by forward modelling of drained triaxial tests.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de endurecimiento plástico para parámetro de estado nulo: módulo adimensional que controla la velocidad con que crece la superficie de fluencia con la deformación plástica de corte, con H = H0 - Hy psi. Se calibra por modelización directa de ensayos triaxiales drenados.
parameters.range_en: 50-500 (typical range of the hardening modulus H for sands)
parameters.range_es: 50-500 (rango típico del módulo de endurecimiento H en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Table 2 (p. 78, H: 50-500) and eq. 14 (p. 85, H = H0 - Hy psi; Fraser River sand H0 = 60, Hy = 280); Itasca 2025, property hardening-0 ('plastic hardening modulus when psi = 0')
parameters.notes: Table 2 gives the range for H, not for H0 separately; H0 is H at psi = 0, so the range is indicative.

parameters.definition_en: Rate of change of the plastic hardening modulus with the state parameter, in H = H0 - Hy psi. With Hy = 0 the modulus is constant and equal to H0.
parameters.definition_es: Variación del módulo de endurecimiento plástico con el parámetro de estado, en H = H0 - Hy psi. Con Hy = 0 el módulo es constante e igual a H0.
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, eq. 14 (p. 85; Fraser River sand Hy = 280) and Table 2 (p. 78, H '60-280 psi' for Fraser River sand); Itasca 2025, property hardening-y (default 0)
parameters.notes: No typical range is published in the sources read; only the Fraser River sand value (280). The RSData tutorial uses Hy = 400.

parameters.definition_en: State-dilatancy coefficient: relates the maximum dilatancy (minimum D) to the state parameter, with triaxial compression as reference. It also sets the internal cap that limits the stress ratio a dense soil can reach.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente estado-dilatancia: relaciona la dilatancia máxima (D mínima) con el parámetro de estado, tomando la compresión triaxial como referencia. Fija también el cap interno que limita la razón de tensiones que puede alcanzar un suelo denso.
parameters.range_en: 2.5-4.5 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 2,5-4,5 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, chi: state-dilatancy parameter), Table 1 (p. 77, eta_L = M_i (1 - chi_i psi_i / M_i,tc)) and Table 2 (p. 78)
parameters.notes: Fraser River sand value: 3.40 (RSData tutorial: 3.2).

parameters.definition_en: Volumetric coupling coefficient taken from Nova's stress-dilatancy rule; together with chi_tc it governs the strength at peak dilatancy.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de acoplamiento volumétrico tomado de la regla tensión-dilatancia de Nova; junto con chi_tc gobierna la resistencia en el pico de dilatancia.
parameters.range_en: 0.2-0.5 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 0,2-0,5 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, N 'volumetric coupling parameter (from Nova's flow rule)'), text p. 76 ('N the volumetric coupling following Nova (1982)') and Table 2 (p. 78)
parameters.notes: Paper p. 76: 'Two properties are associated with strength at peak dilatancy: N ... and chi'. The program default 0.05 is below the published typical range; the RSData tutorial uses 0.5 and Fraser River sand 0.43.

parameters.definition_en: Initial state parameter: the difference between the initial void ratio and the critical-state void ratio at the same mean effective stress (psi = e - e_c). Negative values mean a soil denser than critical (dilatant), positive values a looser, contractive soil.
parameters.definition_es: Parámetro de estado inicial: diferencia entre el índice de poros inicial y el índice de poros crítico a la misma tensión media efectiva (psi = e - e_c). Valores negativos indican un suelo más denso que el crítico (dilatante) y positivos uno más suelto y contractivo.
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 66, psi = e - e_c; subscript 0 = initial condition); Itasca 2025, property state-parameter-initial
parameters.notes: The sign reading follows directly from psi = e - e_c. No typical range is given in the sources read.

parameters.definition_en: Overconsolidation ratio of the initial state, a scalar measure of how far the initial stress lies inside the yield surface. In the FLAC3D implementation it is the ratio of the initial image stress to the image stress that would put the initial stress exactly on the yield surface (OCR = 1).
parameters.definition_es: Índice de sobreconsolidación del estado inicial, medida escalar de cuánto queda la tensión inicial dentro de la superficie de fluencia. En la implementación de FLAC3D es el cociente entre la tensión imagen inicial y la que situaría la tensión inicial justo sobre la superficie de fluencia (OCR = 1).
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 66, R 'scalar measure of overconsolidation'); Itasca 2025, section on initial state ('OCR ... defined as the ratio of the current p_i over the calculated p_i,OCR=1') and property over-consolidation-ratio (default 1)
parameters.notes: Dimensionless ratio. RSData labels it 'OCR (kPa)' (tutorial page), which is a label error. The exact RSData definition is not published; the image-stress definition is Itasca's. RSData tutorial value: 1.1.

parameters.definition_en: Selects how the initial consolidation state of the NorSand sample is given; the only option is OCR, entered in the next field.
parameters.definition_es: Elige cómo se da el estado inicial de consolidación de la muestra NorSand; la única opción es OCR, que se introduce en el campo siguiente.
parameters.locator: RSData tutorial 'NorSand - Fraser River Sand' (Initial Consolidation Condition set to OCR)
parameters.notes: Program (RSData) concept with no scientific original; the tutorial only shows the field, it does not define it. The definition describes the program's option list. See pending list.

parameters.definition_en: Switch that adds an optional softening term to the NorSand hardening rule (the Boolean S of the hardening law). It speeds the softening of loose sand in undrained shear; Itasca advises against using it for drained loading.
parameters.definition_es: Interruptor que añade un término opcional de reblandecimiento a la ley de endurecimiento de NorSand (el booleano S de la ley). Acelera el reblandecimiento de arenas sueltas en corte no drenado; Itasca desaconseja usarlo en carga drenada.
parameters.range_en: Off/on (S = 0 or 1)
parameters.range_es: Desactivado/activado (S = 0 o 1)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Table 1 (p. 77, hardening rule on outer yield surface, 'S = 0 or 1 (a Boolean switch)'); Itasca 2025, property index-softening ('additional cap softening term S T_S ... optional'; not recommended for drained loading)
parameters.notes: The link between the RSData checkbox 'Cap Softening' and the switch S is an inference from Itasca's wording ('cap softening term'); RSData does not document it. Confirm with RSData if possible (see pending list). The RSData tutorial enables it for Fraser River sand.

parameters.definition_en: Bulk modulus of the pore fluid: a measure of its compressibility, i.e. how much the fluid volume changes under a change of pressure.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de compresibilidad volumétrica del fluido intersticial: medida de su compresibilidad, es decir, de cuánto cambia el volumen del fluido ante un cambio de presión.
parameters.locator: RS2 help 'Define Hydraulic Properties', section Fluid Bulk Modulus (definition); RSData NorSand tutorial (Fluid Bulk Modulus 1e9 kPa)
parameters.notes: Only a Rocscience manual defines it (generic physical property, software field); kind manual. Its role in the RSData NorSand test simulation is not documented in what was read. No range or value for water sourced (see pending).

parameters.definition_en: Multiplier of the Power Curve shear strength envelope tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c (+ sigma_n tan theta_w), usually obtained by least-squares fitting of shear test data.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente multiplicador de la envolvente de resistencia al corte Power Curve tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c (+ sigma_n tan theta_w), obtenido normalmente por ajuste de mínimos cuadrados a ensayos de corte.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20 'Slide-Isotropic Models', section 20.2, eq. 20.3; RocData User's Guide 2004, 'Power Curve Criterion' (pp. 6-7) and 'Power Curve Parameters' (p. 23)
parameters.notes: Software criterion (RocData/Slide) with no single scientific original in the sources read; kind manual. Unit implied by the equation: stress^(1-b), so the value of a depends on the stress unit (kPa in the program) unless b = 1. RocData also gives the dimensionless form tau = A Pa ((sigma_n/Pa) + T)^n.

parameters.definition_en: Exponent of the Power Curve envelope tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c; b < 1 gives an envelope that curves down with normal stress and b = 1 a straight line.
parameters.definition_es: Exponente de la envolvente Power Curve tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c; b < 1 da una envolvente que se curva hacia abajo con la tensión normal y b = 1 una recta.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, eq. 20.3; RocData User's Guide 2004, 'Power Curve Criterion' (pp. 6-7, curved envelopes at low normal stress)
parameters.notes: Dimensionless. The shape statement follows from the equation itself.

parameters.definition_en: Constant shear strength added to the power term in tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c, obtained, like a and b, by least-squares fitting of shear test data.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia al corte constante que se suma al término potencial en tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c; se obtiene, como a y b, por ajuste de mínimos cuadrados a ensayos de corte.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2, eq. 20.3; Slide3 help 'Power Curve'
parameters.notes: Stress unit (kPa). Not in the 2004 RocData form (tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b). OGR-Data's criteria_envelopes.py currently ignores c and waviness 'until their exact semantics are verified': eq. 20.3 now gives them.

parameters.definition_en: Shift of the normal-stress axis in tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c, which represents the tensile strength; if used it must be entered as a positive value.
parameters.definition_es: Desplazamiento del eje de tensiones normales en tau = a (sigma_n + d)^b + c, que representa la resistencia a tracción; si se usa debe introducirse como valor positivo.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2 ('The d parameter represents the tensile strength ... positive value'); Slide3 help 'Power Curve'; RocData User's Guide 2004, p. 6
parameters.notes: Stress unit (kPa). Not the GHB disturbance factor D. The RS2 doc also says the equivalent elastoplastic model has zero peak and residual tensile strength.

parameters.definition_en: Waviness angle of a joint, added to the strength as sigma_n tan(theta_w): the average dip of the failure plane minus its minimum dip, for undulations seen over about 1 to 10 m. A non-zero value always raises the shear strength; use 0 when not modelling a joint.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de ondulación de la junta, que se suma a la resistencia como sigma_n tan(theta_w): buzamiento medio del plano de rotura menos su buzamiento mínimo, para ondulaciones observadas en distancias de 1 a 10 m aproximadamente. Un valor no nulo siempre aumenta la resistencia al corte; se deja en 0 si no se modeliza una junta.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, eq. 20.3 (term sigma_n tan theta_W, 'waviness angle defined for joints (Miller 1988)'); Slide3 help 'Power Curve', waviness angle paragraph; RocPlane help 'Failure Shear Strength', waviness paragraph ('observed over distances on the order of 1 m to 10 m'; a non-zero angle always increases the shear strength)
parameters.notes: The scientific original is Miller, S.M. (1988), Modeling shear strength at low normal stresses for enhanced rock slope engineering, Proc. 39th Highway Geology Symposium, 346-356 (cited by Rocscience, not read).
