parameters.definition_en: Parameter a of the residual Power Curve envelope; the residual strength uses the same formulation as the peak, tau_r = a_r (sigma_n + d_r)^b_r + c_r (+ sigma_n tan theta_w,r).
parameters.definition_es: Parámetro a de la envolvente residual Power Curve; la resistencia residual usa la misma formulación que la de pico, tau_r = a_r (sigma_n + d_r)^b_r + c_r (+ sigma_n tan theta_w,r).
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2 ('The residual strength ... uses the same formulation as the peak strength')
parameters.notes: Software concept (residual strength of the RS2/RSData elastoplastic equivalent). Same unit remark as a.

parameters.definition_en: Exponent b of the residual Power Curve envelope (same formulation as the peak envelope).
parameters.definition_es: Exponente b de la envolvente residual Power Curve (misma formulación que la envolvente de pico).
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2
parameters.notes: Software concept; see residual_a.

parameters.definition_en: Constant shear strength c of the residual Power Curve envelope (same formulation as the peak envelope).
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia al corte constante c de la envolvente residual Power Curve (misma formulación que la envolvente de pico).
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2
parameters.notes: Software concept; stress unit (kPa).

parameters.definition_en: Normal-stress shift d (tensile strength term) of the residual Power Curve envelope (same formulation as the peak envelope).
parameters.definition_es: Desplazamiento d de tensiones normales (término de resistencia a tracción) de la envolvente residual Power Curve (misma formulación que la envolvente de pico).
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2
parameters.notes: Software concept; stress unit (kPa).

parameters.definition_en: Joint waviness angle used in the residual Power Curve envelope (same formulation as the peak envelope).
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de ondulación de la junta usado en la envolvente residual Power Curve (misma formulación que la envolvente de pico).
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2 and eq. 20.3
parameters.notes: Software concept; see waviness.

parameters.definition_en: Constant ratio used to obtain the dilation angle of the plastic flow from the instantaneous friction angle of the Power Curve envelope at the current stress.
parameters.definition_es: Razón constante con la que se obtiene el ángulo de dilatancia del flujo plástico a partir del ángulo de rozamiento instantáneo de la envolvente Power Curve en el estado tensional actual.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.2 ('a constant dilation ratio is considered to find the equivalent dilation angle based on the instantaneous friction angle')
parameters.notes: Software concept (RS2/RSData elastoplastic equivalent), kind manual. The doc does not write the formula (presumably psi = ratio x phi_inst) nor a range; see pending.

parameters.definition_en: Residual friction angle of the joint surface in Barton's criterion tau = sigma_n tan(phi_r + JRC log10(JCS/sigma_n)). It can be estimated from the basic friction angle of sawn surfaces and Schmidt rebounds: phi_r = (phi_b - 20) + 20 r/R.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de rozamiento residual de la superficie de la junta en el criterio de Barton tau = sigma_n tan(phi_r + JRC log10(JCS/sigma_n)). Puede estimarse a partir del ángulo de rozamiento básico de superficies serradas y del rebote del esclerómetro Schmidt: phi_r = (phi_b - 20) + 20 r/R.
parameters.range_en: About 25-35 deg for unaltered joint walls, 25-30 deg slightly altered, 20-25 deg with silty or sandy-clay coatings, 8-16 deg with softening clay coatings; basic friction angles of common rocks 23-40 deg
parameters.range_es: Del orden de 25-35° en paredes no alteradas, 25-30° ligeramente alteradas, 20-25° con recubrimientos limo-arcillosos o areno-arcillosos y 8-16° con recubrimientos arcillosos blandos; ángulos de rozamiento básicos de rocas comunes 23-40°
parameters.locator: Hoek 2023, ch. 4, eqs. 4-5 (PDF p. 82, after Barton & Choubey 1977); Hoek 2023, ch. 12, Table 6, joint alteration number Ja, column phi_r approx. (PDF pp. 252-253, after Barton et al. 1974); FHWA 1989, p. 5.18, margin table 'basic friction angle for different rocks' (after Barton); RS2 Theory 20, eq. 20.1
parameters.notes: r = Schmidt rebound on wet weathered joint walls, R = on dry unweathered sawn surfaces. With r = R the formula gives phi_r = phi_b, which is why the program's pick table (basic_friction_angle.json, FHWA 1989) applies to unweathered joints. The original papers Barton & Choubey (1977) and Barton et al. (1974) were not read directly.

parameters.definition_en: Joint roughness coefficient: a number that rates the roughness of the joint surface, estimated by visual comparison with Barton and Choubey's standard profiles or from asperity amplitude over a straight edge. It decreases with block size (scale effect, Barton and Bandis 1982).
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de rugosidad de la junta: número que califica la rugosidad de la superficie, estimado por comparación visual con los perfiles tipo de Barton y Choubey o a partir de la amplitud de las asperezas bajo una regla. Disminuye con el tamaño del bloque (efecto escala, Barton y Bandis 1982).
parameters.range_en: 0-20 (0-2 smooth planar profile to 18-20 very rough profile)
parameters.range_es: 0-20 (0-2 perfil liso y plano a 18-20 perfil muy rugoso)
parameters.locator: Hoek 2023, ch. 4, eq. 4 and Figure 5 (PDF pp. 82-83, profiles JRC 0-2 ... 18-20 after Barton & Choubey 1977), Figure 6 (Barton 1982), eq. 6 scale correction (PDF p. 85); FHWA 1989, Figure 5.2 (p. 5.8: rough undulating JRC = 20, smooth undulating 10, smooth nearly planar 5) and p. 5.19
parameters.notes: Dimensionless. Laboratory-scale JRC0 refers to 100 mm samples.

parameters.definition_en: Joint wall compressive strength: the uniaxial compressive strength of the rock right at the joint walls. It equals that of the intact rock for fresh walls and is lower for weathered walls; it also decreases with block size (Barton and Bandis 1982).
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión de las paredes de la junta: resistencia a compresión simple de la roca en las propias paredes de la discontinuidad. Coincide con la de la roca intacta en paredes sanas y es menor en paredes meteorizadas; además disminuye con el tamaño del bloque (Barton y Bandis 1982).
parameters.range_en: From the uniaxial compressive strength of the intact rock (fresh walls) down to about one quarter of it (weathered walls)
parameters.range_es: Desde la resistencia a compresión simple de la roca intacta (paredes sanas) hasta aproximadamente una cuarta parte de ella (paredes meteorizadas)
parameters.locator: Hoek 2023, ch. 4, eq. 4 (PDF p. 82) and eq. 7 scale correction (PDF p. 85); FHWA 1989, p. 5.18 (weathering can reduce the near-surface strength to as low as one quarter of the intact uniaxial strength, after Barton)
parameters.notes: Stress unit (kPa). Validity of Barton's equation: FHWA p. 5.7 recommends 0.01 < sigma_n/JCS < 0.3 and an upper limit of 70 deg for the bracketed angle; Hoek ch. 4, PDF pp. 88-89: not valid at sigma_n = 0, upper limit sigma_n = JCS. The program default 1e7 kPa (10 000 MPa) is far above any rock strength (RSData default).

parameters.definition_en: Dilation angle of the plastic potential of the elastoplastic Barton-Bandis model (the program label is 'Dilation Angle'); after failure the material is cohesionless with friction angle phi_r.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de dilatancia del potencial plástico del modelo elastoplástico Barton-Bandis (la etiqueta del programa es 'Dilation Angle'); tras la rotura el material es friccional sin cohesión con ángulo de rozamiento phi_r.
parameters.locator: RS2 Theory 20, section 20.1 ('A dilation angle, psi, is defined for the plastic potential function'; residual strength cohesionless with phi_r) and eq. 20.2
parameters.notes: Software concept (RS2/RSData elastoplastic equivalent of the Barton-Bandis criterion), kind manual. The registry key says 'residual_' but the RS2 doc defines a single dilation angle; no range sourced.

pending.missing: PENDING: not defined in the Rocscience Softening-Hardening theory manual (ch. 11) nor in any other document read; the RS2 online help and the Rocscience learning page checked do not describe the field. See pending_camclay_softening.md.
